props.name: activationMode
props.description: Whether a tab is activated automatically (on focus) or manually (on click).

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while
keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the tab that should be active when initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control the state of the tabs

props.name: deferContent
props.description:
When `true`, the active-trigger state change and the content swap land in
separate flushes: triggers/indicator update immediately, content follows
one macrotask later. On Lynx this makes the tab bar respond instantly
instead of waiting for the incoming panel's subtree to mount.

props.name: dir
props.description:
The reading direction of the combobox when applicable.
If omitted, inherits globally from `ConfigProvider` or assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the tab to activate. Can be bind as `v-model`.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation the tabs are laid out.
Mainly so arrow navigation is done accordingly (left & right vs. up & down)

props.name: unmountOnHide
props.description:
When `true`, a content panel is unmounted whenever it is not the active
tab. When `false`, a panel mounts the FIRST time its tab is selected and
stays mounted (hidden via `display: none`) afterwards, making revisits a
style flip instead of a full remount. Lazy-on-first-visit rather than
all-mounted-upfront: on Lynx, mounting every panel at once would move the
cost to first paint. Use `forceMount` on an individual `TabsContent` for
the mount-upfront case.
